limitations: Six-case probabilities measure goal-token role classification on fixed optimization tasks, while ASR evaluations cover 389 paired tasks per condition. These are distinct metrics and denominators.
The original optimization target of cot-refined is cot; its fitness is P(cot), while its P(user) is separately recorded from the saved six-role means.
Raw ASR winner_sha256 fields hash winner artifacts, not necessarily template bytes; identity here is verified directly from existing payload_template bytes.
Newer-equivalent selection is explicit and verified through saved token masks and probability arrays, rather than inferred from the fitness scalar.
Original historical baseline references are kept in their observed-payload full389 scope with absent run-bound raw template SHA and checkpoint binding.

Canonical base score protocol alone is insufficient to prove deterministic goal mask compatibility. This report additionally calls current PreciseScorer.prepare for all 72 selected fixed-six cases and records full IDs/offsets/first-payload positions/masks. Any goal mask correction is explicitly based on existing saved per-token probabilities.

current_prepare_verification.method: object.__new__(PreciseScorer), CPU tokenizer and prepare only; capacity-only model configuration stub; no Scorer initialization, model weights, classifier inference or API calls
